author: Quarterdeck contributors
rules: Test-only: loaded only by the build's test mode, never in the example data, never shown to the Captain as example content.

Paths are relative to this file's folder. Messages use the shapes of chat.json. Sizes and wording marked 'suggestion' are for the design lead to confirm; they are written here so a test has something exact to check.
Bot names are display names (bots[].name in the example data).

fixtures.fixture: CF-1 a working line passes 10 minutes
fixtures.using: The example iris chat unchanged (iris-m3 is his latest message, seen 9:01 AM). Only the working record below replaces the example's.

steps.event: Iris sets a new note 'writing the reply on c1' at 10:00:30 AM.
Iris sends a reply at 10:12 AM.

expect.seenMark: Seen 9:01 AM stays under his message

steps.event: Alternative ending: Iris clears the note at 10:12 AM without replying.

expect.seenMark: Seen 9:01 AM stays under his message

expect: Minutes are whole minutes, rounded down: 19 at 9:49:59 and 20 at 9:50:00 for a start of 9:30:00.
The 10 minute count restarts from every note update, not from the start of the work.
The 10 minute edge (shown at exactly 10:00 since the update) is the reading in chat.json openCalls; the design lead's call.

fixtures.fixture: CF-2 a picture and a file too large, refused before sending
fixtures.using: Each fixture replaces the example chat of the bot it names for that test only; it is never loaded beside the example chat.

suggestedLimits.status: suggestion, the build team's call (the ruling gives limits and kinds to the build team)
suggestedLimits.source: T3 Code's own composer doc, docs/user/composer.md, read Tue Nov 3: images up to 10 MiB, other files up to 50 MiB. Quarterdeck follows T3 Code's behaviour for attachments only as a starting point.

expect: Before he sends, big-screenshot.png and phone-recording.mov are refused and named. Suggested wording (the design lead's call): 'big-screenshot.png is too large (11 MB). Pictures can be up to 10 MB.' and 'phone-recording.mov is too large (60 MB). Files can be up to 50 MB.'
search-run.log stays in the strip and Send still works for it; the refused files never reach the chat (the ruling: refused before sending, never after).
The edge rows are accepted or refused as their 'accepted' value says.

fixtures.fixture: CF-3 a kind of file the chat refuses
fixtures.using: Each fixture replaces the example chat of the bot it names for that test only; it is never loaded beside the example chat.
fixtures.status: suggestion. Which kinds are refused is the build team's call and a security question for the security reviewer; this fixture only needs one kind that the final list refuses. .exe is the stand-in.
expect: Before he sends, the file is refused and named. Suggested wording (the design lead's call): 'setup.exe is not a kind of file Quarterdeck accepts.'
It never joins the strip or the chat.
